# The paths that can change a convergence leg's verdict.
#
# Read by `.github/scripts/kick-convergence.sh` (Main dispatches the convergence suites
# only for a push that touches one of these) and by `.github/scripts/convergence-bisect.sh`
# (which bisects only over commits that do). One list, so the two cannot disagree about
# what a "pipeline commit" is: a commit the dispatcher skipped is one the bisect also skips.
#
# `dir/**` is everything under `dir/`; anything else is an exact file path — the
# `.github/actions/changed-paths/matches.sh` dialect.
common/src/main/**
worker/src/main/**
worker/src/fixtures/**
testkit/src/main/**
# e2e dependsOn(web): the legs read their schedules through MovieControllerService, and
# nothing else of the web. Its file and every web source it reaches, which
# ConvergenceDispatchGateSpec recomputes, so a new dependency cannot go unlisted.
web/src/main/scala/controllers/MovieControllerService.scala
web/src/main/scala/controllers/StartedShowtimeCut.scala
web/src/main/scala/controllers/WebHref.scala
e2e/**
build.sbt
project/**
.jvmopts
test/resources/fixtures/corpus/**
.github/convergence-paths.txt
.github/workflows/identity-model-convergence.yml
.github/workflows/country-convergence-leg.yml
.github/actions/convergence-setup/**
.github/actions/setup-jdk/**
.github/actions/sbt-target-cache/**
.github/actions/convergence-publish/**
.github/actions/convergence-overlay-publish/**
.github/actions/convergence-findings/**
.github/scripts/carry-overlay.sh
.github/scripts/pack-enrichment-tree.sh
.github/scripts/unpack-fixture-archive.sh
.github/scripts/restore-enrichment-tree.sh
.github/scripts/restore-identity-overlay.sh
.github/scripts/sample-recordings.sh
.github/scripts/convergence-bisect.sh
# The CI plumbing a leg runs: its preflight, the release reads and writes behind its pinned
# pair, and the status that IS its verdict on the commit. (ConvergenceDispatchGateSpec walks
# the convergence workflows and fails on any repository file they run that is not listed.)
.github/actions/leg-verdict/**
scripts/ci/leg-verdict.sh
scripts/ci/gh-release.sh
scripts/ci/gh-optional.sh
scripts/ci/preflight.sh
scripts/ci/start-mongo-replset.sh
scripts/ci/in-background.sh
scripts/ci/wait-for-run-artifact.sh
scripts/ci/install-apt-package.sh
scripts/ci/drop-microsoft-apt-sources.sh
# A recording leg's corpus capture: the tunnel it opens and closes around the read.
scripts/ci/wait-for-mongo-tunnel.sh
scripts/ci/close-mongo-tunnel.sh
scripts/ci/mongo-tunnel-paths.sh
